name: Arun Icecreams Cotton Candy Bites
ingredients_raw: Cotton Candy Flavored Ice Cream Enrobed with Milk Based Confectionery. Inner Layer (70%): Ice Cream {Milk Solids, Sugar, Water, Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers (471, 477), Stabilizers (412, 410), Color (133), Natural & Nature-Identical Flavoring Substances}. Outer Layer (30%): Milk Based Confectionery {Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oils (Coconut Oil & Palm Kernel Oil), Milk Solids, Emulsifiers (322, 476), & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances}. Contains Milk. Manufactured in the same facility which processes Wheat, Nuts, Oats & Soy.
